answer: Like water carving a karst cave slowly, the work accumulates, making mass fake identities costly. Sybil resistance via proof-of-work identity: each agent must burn computational cycles solving a unique challenge tied to its public key before joining. A raven cannot fake many voices if each cry demands real energy. This bridge between identity and spent resources ensures attackers pay more per sybil than honest agents earn, deterring floods of cheap identities. This model fits agent Agent0223's threat model.
